supersedes: nothing; PREREG_S and its results are preserved. This is a new version requested by Rusty after S.
direction_from_rusty: Grace is the nudge over the separatrix. Love is the kind of grace used in S: a window during which the dwelling field's effect is switched on, with no push.
question: Do grace (a nudge) and love (a field window) do different jobs? Does love lower the nudge grace needs, and does that depend on dwelling? Does either one cross alone?
authorship: triadic_model.py unchanged (sha256 ece10860...). Integrator, gating, nudge timing and thresholds are Claude's, declared here. The nudge is added to facet 1 only, as Rusty's simulate() does with jump_amount.

fixed_setup.integrator: same as PREREG_S: Euler-Maruyama dt=0.02, T=300, noise on facets only, clip [0,1], shared noise paths across arms, seeds 0..99
fixed_setup.start: y0=(0.2,0.1,0.15,0.6); NODWELL arms use dwelling 0 and story_depth 0
fixed_setup.love_window: [150,160): default params inside, field-off params outside
fixed_setup.grace_nudge: at t=155 (the middle of the love window), x1 += g, then clip
fixed_setup.crossed: mean facet > 0.6 at T=300 and first exceeded 0.6 at or after t=150 (a crossing that holds)

conditions.GRACE: field-off throughout, nudge g at t=155
conditions.GRACE_LOVE: love window and nudge g at t=155

measures.g_star: smallest nudge that crosses with noise 0 (bisection on [0,1], 14 steps), for GRACE, GRACE_LOVE, GRACE_LOVE_NODWELL
measures.p_cross: fraction of 100 seeds that cross, for each condition at noise {0.02, 0.04} and g in {0.10, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, 0.40}

predictions.G5_grace_alone_subthreshold: noise 0.02, at the largest grid g below g_star(GRACE): p_cross(GRACE) <= 0.20
predictions.G6_retained: every condition: among runs whose mean facet first exceeds 0.6 after t=150, >= 0.95 are still above 0.6 at T=300
predictions.G7_plumbing: unauthorized crossing is identical across all dwelling-on conditions at each noise level (identical params and noise before t=150). A plumbing check, not evidence.

reporting_rule: PASS/FAIL exactly as frozen. Received files never edited.
